name: Reactify – Post Reactions, Emoji Reactions & Engagement Analytics for WordPress
author: WP Plugify

sections.description:

Reactify – Post Reactions for WordPress

Make your WordPress content more interactive with beautiful, customizable post reactions.

Reactify is a lightweight and easy-to-use WordPress reaction plugin that lets visitors quickly express how they feel about your posts with a simple click.

Instead of relying only on likes or comments, give your audience a more engaging way to interact with your content using emoji and reaction buttons.

Turn Readers Into Active Participants

A simple reaction can encourage visitors to interact with your content without requiring them to write a comment or fill out a form.

Reactify is ideal for:

  • Blogs
  • News and magazine websites
  • Educational websites
  • Review websites
  • Community websites
  • Content creators
  • Business and corporate websites

Powerful Features in the Free Version

Reactify gives you everything you need to add an attractive reaction system to your WordPress website.

Beautiful Reaction Interface

Add modern reaction buttons that integrate naturally with your website and give visitors an easy way to respond to your content.

Multiple Reaction Layouts

Choose a layout that works best for your website and content style.

Emoji Reactions

Let visitors express their feelings using engaging emoji-based reactions.

Customizable Colors

Match the reaction interface with your website’s branding using customizable colors for different elements.

Reaction Results

Show visitors how others have reacted to your content with clear reaction results and percentages.

Flexible Display Options

Control where your reactions appear and create an experience that works naturally with your content.

Responsive Design

Reactify is designed to work across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Lightweight & Performance Focused

Built with a focus on clean implementation and minimal impact on your WordPress website.

Designed to Fit Your Website

Reactify gives you control over the appearance of your reaction interface without requiring coding knowledge.

Customize the look and feel of your reactions to complement your existing WordPress theme.

Want More Control?

Reactify Pro takes your reaction system further with advanced customization and engagement features.

Upgrade to Pro for additional capabilities such as:

  • Advanced reaction layouts and presets
  • More advanced styling controls
  • Enhanced sizing and spacing options
  • Google Fonts support
  • Advanced appearance customization
  • More powerful analytics and engagement insights
  • Additional controls for creating a unique reaction experience

Whether you are running a personal blog or a growing content platform, Reactify gives you a simple way to make your content more interactive.

Start with Reactify Free and upgrade to Reactify Pro when you need more advanced control and engagement features.

Why Reactify?

Easy to use – Set up your reactions without complicated configuration.

Beautiful – Create a reaction interface that fits your website.

Flexible – Customize layouts, colors, and appearance.

Responsive – Works across modern devices and screen sizes.

Lightweight – Built with performance in mind.

Extendable – Upgrade to Reactify Pro when your website needs more advanced features.

Reactify — Give your visitors a better way to react to your content.

Support

Get free dedicated support from our developers.
sections.installation:
1. Login to your WordPress Admin Area

    1. Go to Plugins > Add New
    2. Type “Reactify” into the Search and hit Enter.
    3. Find this plugin Click “Install now”
    4. Activate The Plugin
    5. Use Reactify on any themes that allow users to review and reaction.

    Manual Installation

    1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org repository
    2. On your WordPress admin dashboard, go to ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin’
    3. Upload the downloaded plugin file (reactify.zip) and click ‘Install Now’
    4. Activate ‘Reactify’ from your Plugins page.
    5. Use Reactify on any themes that allow users to review and reaction.
sections.faq:
What is Reactify?

Reactify is a WordPress post reaction plugin that lets visitors interact with your content using customizable reactions and emojis. It provides a simple alternative to traditional likes and comments.

Is Reactify free?

Yes. Reactify has a free version available through WordPress.org with essential features for adding reactions to your WordPress website.

How do I add reactions to my posts?

After installing and activating Reactify, configure your preferred reaction settings from the WordPress dashboard. Reactify can then display reactions on supported content according to your settings.

Can I customize the appearance of reactions?

Yes. Reactify includes customization options for colors, layouts, reaction appearance, and other visual settings so you can match the reaction interface with your website.

Does Reactify support emoji reactions?

Yes. Reactify supports emoji-based reactions, allowing visitors to quickly express their feelings about your content.

Can visitors see the reaction results?

Yes. Reactify can display reaction results and percentages, allowing visitors to see how other users have responded to the content.

Is Reactify responsive?

Yes. Reactify is designed to provide a responsive experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I use Reactify with any WordPress theme?

Reactify is designed to work with a wide range of modern WordPress themes. Because themes can have different structures and customizations, compatibility may vary in some highly customized themes.

Does Reactify require coding knowledge?

No. Reactify is designed to be configured from the WordPress dashboard, so you can set up and customize your reactions without writing code.

Will Reactify slow down my website?

Reactify is built with performance in mind and aims to keep its frontend footprint lightweight. As with any plugin, the overall impact can depend on your WordPress setup, theme, hosting environment, and other active plugins.

Can I use Reactify on a blog or news website?

Yes. Reactify is particularly useful for blogs, news portals, magazines, educational websites, reviews, and other content-focused websites where visitor engagement is important.

Does Reactify have a Pro version?

Yes. Reactify Pro provides additional customization and advanced engagement features for users who need more control over their reaction system.

What do I get with Reactify Pro?

Reactify Pro adds advanced capabilities such as additional layouts and presets, enhanced styling and sizing controls, Google Fonts support, advanced appearance customization, and more powerful analytics and engagement features.

Can I start with the Free version and upgrade later?

Yes. You can start with Reactify Free and upgrade to Reactify Pro whenever you need additional features and customization options.

Where can I get Reactify Pro?

You can learn more about Reactify Pro and its additional features from the official WPPlugify website.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 – August 20, 2026

  • Fix – Fixed the filename by correcting the case-sensitive characters.
  • Fix – Fixed the Reactify Free activation fatal error caused by the incorrect field manager file path.
  • Fix – Fixed compatibility issues when Reactify Free and Reactify Pro are active simultaneously.
  • Fix – Fixed the Free to Pro settings migration to ensure existing Free settings are migrated correctly.
  • Fix – Fixed duplicate migration issues by making the Free to Pro migration process idempotent.
  • Fix – Fixed emoji picker and Add Emoji workflow issues.
  • Fix – Fixed reaction settings and design settings UI alignment issues.
  • Fix – Fixed color picker and frontend color application issues.
  • Fix – Fixed typography font loading and selected Google Font application.
  • Fix – Fixed Enable Emoji Hover functionality.
  • Fix – Fixed analytics date filter access issues.
  • Fix – Fixed reaction count and default reaction design consistency.
  • Fix – Fixed Post Reactions Settings meta box styling in the WordPress editor.
  • Fix – Fixed various admin UI spacing, button, icon, and form control inconsistencies.
  • Imp – Removed CSV Export functionality from the Free version.
  • Imp – Improved the Post Reactions Settings meta box design.
  • Imp – Improved admin settings controls, including color pickers and range controls.
  • Imp – Improved compatibility between Reactify Free and Reactify Pro.
  • Imp – Preserved Free settings and data during Pro activation and migration.
  • Imp – Removed obsolete automatic Free plugin deactivation functionality.

1.0.6 – February 13, 2026

  • Fix – Fixed the filename by correcting the case-sensitive characters.

1.0.5 – January 15, 2026

  • Enhance – Plugin dashboard UI for better usability and appearance.

  • Add – Link to documentation and support in the dashboard.

  • Fix – Tasks listed by the admin reviewer.

  • Fix – Issue reported by plugin team.

1.0.1 – Jan 30, 2025
